title: Sorry, these are not good
text: Sorry, these are not good. I rarely give one star, but this spoon has no feedback and I want to be clear. First, these are not "shiny" like silverware typically is. They are dull. Second, it is clear these have been stamped out of metal with no further work. They are sharp along the edges of the spoon, it nicked my finger. Lastly, the bowl of the spoon is very shallow. I'm not sure what would stay in it. I feel bad as people are all just trying to make a living but these spoons are not for me.
